verdict.rationale: Agora documents recording of audio and video streams and a server-side mixing and compositing service, which together suggest multi-participant streams can be combined into one output. The evidence never explicitly ties compositing to recording output and describes no layout options. Missing for 10: documented composite/mixed recording mode, documented layout options (grid, speaker, custom), configuration details or API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options

citations.quote: Flexible options to record audio streams, video streams, and web pages for archive, review, or distribution.
Transform audio & video streams with server-side mixing and compositing
